definitions.meaning: For that, for that reason which, for, because

quotations.old_english: Eádige synd ða gástlícan þearfan, forðam hyra ys heofena ríce
quotations.english: blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
quotations.citations: Mt. Bos. 5, 3: Ps. Spl. 24, 22: Beo. Th. 301; B. 149: Cd. 167; Th. 209, 30; Exod. 507: Runic pm. 20; Kmbl. 343, 15; Hick. Thes. i. 135, 40

quotations.old_english: Swíðost he fór ðyder for ðǽm horshwælum, forðæm hí habbaþ swýðe æðele bán on hyra tóþum
quotations.english: he went there chiefly for the walruses, because they have very good bone in their teeth

quotations.old_english: Me ðæt gelǽrdon leóde míne ðæt ic ðé sóhte, forðan hie mægenes cræft mínne cúðon
quotations.english: my people counselled me that I should seek thee, because they knew my capacity of strength
quotations.citations: Beo. Th. 840; B. 418: Ps. Spl. 6, 2: Apstls. Kmbl. 93; Ap. 47: Menol. Fox 42; Men. 21

quotations.old_english: Hí wíte þoliaþ forðon hie þegnscipe Godes forgýmdon
quotations.english: they suffer torment because they neglected the service of God

quotations.old_english: Eádige synd ða ðe nú wépaþ, forðamðe hí beóþ gefréfrede
quotations.english: blessed are they who weep now, for they shall be comforted

quotations.old_english: Næfþ ðys word [willan] nǽnne imper&a-long;t&i-long;vum, forðanðe se willa sceall beón ǽfre frig
quotations.english: this verb [to will] has no imperative, for the will must always be free
quotations.citations: Ælfc. Gr. 32; Som. 36, 11: Homl. Th. ii. 290, 1, 3, 25

quotations.old_english: Forðonðe sió sunne ðǽr gǽþ neár on setl, ðonne on óðrum lande, ðǽr syndon lýðran wedera ðonne on Brittannia
quotations.english: because the sun in its setting goes nearer there than in any other land, there are milder weathers than in Britain

source_text: for-ðam, for-ðæm, for-ðan, for-ðon, for-ðam-ðe, for-ðæm-ðe, for-ðan-ðe, for-ðon-ðe; conj, [for that which] For that, for that reason which, for, because; nam, quia :-- Eádige synd ða gástlícan þearfan, forðam hyra ys heofena ríce blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven, Mt. Bos. 5, 3: Ps. Spl. 24, 22: Beo. Th. 301; B. 149: Cd. 167; Th. 209, 30; Exod. 507: Runic pm. 20; Kmbl. 343, 15; Hick. Thes. i. 135, 40. Bos. 5, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12: Cd. 184; Th. 230, 1; Dan. 226: Bt. Met. Fox 20, 73; Met. 20, 37. Næfþ ðys word [willan] nǽnne imper&a-long;t&i-long;vum, forðanðe se willa sceall beón ǽfre frig this verb [to will] has no imperative, for the will must always be free, Ælfc. Gr. 32; Som. 36, 11: Homl. Th. ii. 290, 1, 3, 25.
